walkthrough.title: New to HatchGrab?
walkthrough.body: A quick tour of what lives on each tab. Takes about a minute.

getApp.title: Get the app
getApp.body: The kitchen app runs your service on a phone or tablet — and it is the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal. Free with your account, on iPhone, iPad and Android.

logo.label: Logo
logo.removeConfirm: Remove your logo? Customers will see your truck name without it. You can upload a new one at any time.
logo.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove the logo — please try again.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.intro: How customers reach you about their order (shown on order confirmations) and where you receive new-order alerts. For your personal account details, go to Team → My profile.
contact.emailError: Please enter a valid email (e.g. hello@yourtruck.com)
contact.emailHelp: Where you receive new-order notifications — and shown to customers on their confirmation when “Email” is the preferred method below.
contact.previousMethodGone: Your previous contact method is no longer available. Please select a new one.
contact.preferredHelp: How customers should contact you about their order — shown on their confirmation email.
contact.addEmailOrPhone: Add an email or phone above to offer a contact method.
contact.tickWhatsApp: ⚠️ Tick “This number is on WhatsApp” on the Phone field to use WhatsApp.

orders.acceptingHelp: What happens when a new order arrives.
orders.notificationsHelp: How you hear about new orders.
orders.emailNotificationsHelp: {hasEmail, select, yes {When on, an email is sent to {email} for every new order. Customer order emails are sent either way.} other {When on, an email is sent to the truck’s contact email for every new order. Customer order emails are sent either way.}}
orders.openCloseHelp: When your events start and stop taking online orders.
orders.autoOpenHelp: Events open for online orders at your event start time
orders.autoCloseHelp: Events stop taking orders at your event end time

preorders.ruleSummary: {type, select, hours_before {Order by {hours, plural, one {{count} hour} other {{count} hours}} before the event} other {Order by {time} on the event day}} · {action, select, force_pending {needs approval} other {sold out}}
preorders.title: Pre-orders
preorders.intro: Let customers order ahead of an event. Set when pre-orders open and the deadline rules below — these apply only to the items you select.
preorders.openOnConfirm: As soon as event is confirmed
preorders.openDaysBefore: {n, plural, one {{count} day before} other {{count} days before}}
preorders.deadlineHelp: Set pre-order rule to prevent ordering of items after a specified time.
preorders.soldOutHelp: Customers can’t order it after the deadline.
preorders.approvalHelp: Customers can still order, but the order needs your approval (won’t auto-accept).
preorders.noneYet: No items selected yet — “Configure items” to add some.
preorders.allUseRule: All selected items use the rule above: <hl>{rule}</hl>.
preorders.modalHelp: Tick which items are pre-order. They all use the global rule ({rule}).

vans.title: Your trucks
vans.help: Manage your trucks. Each has its own order screen and settings.
vans.sameAs: {hasName, select, yes {Same as {name}} other {Same as the first van}}
vans.sameOn: This van uses the same settings, except kitchen capacity.
vans.sameOff: Copy the first van’s settings — everything except kitchen capacity — and keep them in step.
vans.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card” so your takings reconcile against the till. You can turn this on for a single event from the dashboard.
vans.addConfirm:
Adding an additional truck will be charged as an add-on to your subscription.

This will be reflected in your next billing cycle.

Do you want to continue?

collection.help: How far apart collection times are. This doesn’t change kitchen capacity or prep times.
collection.unavailable: Collection times are unavailable right now.
collection.canPick: {who, select, customers {Customers can pick {example}} other {You and your customers can pick {example}}}
collection.differentTimes: Use different times for orders I add
collection.misaligned: {name} takes {mins, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} to cook, so some times between batches will show as full.

removeVan.title: Remove {name}?
removeVan.body: This van will be removed from your account and will no longer appear on your dashboard or in future events.
removeVan.preservedOrders: ✓ Preserved: All historical orders, sales data, and reports are kept permanently.
removeVan.preservedEvents: ✓ Preserved: Past event records linked to this van are unaffected.
removeVan.removedLink: ✕ Removed: The van’s kitchen screen link and settings will be deactivated.

vanBilling.title: Add another truck
vanBilling.body: Your {plan} plan includes {vans, plural, one {# truck} other {# trucks}}. Adding an additional truck costs {price} and will be added to your next billing cycle.
vanBilling.note: ⚠️ Note: Billing adjustment is processed manually during early access. You will receive a confirmation email within 24 hours.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we’ll check it for you, sending any events we find for your approval. This needs to be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
schedule.eitherWay: Either way, if we find your events listed elsewhere, we’ll still send these to you for approval. Nothing goes live until you confirm it.
schedule.wherePost: Where do you post your schedule?
schedule.checkingHelp: This can take up to 2 minutes — please keep this page open and don’t close the tab.
schedule.urlHelp: Your website where customers can see your upcoming events — not a Facebook or Instagram page
schedule.exclusionsHelp: These terms are automatically filtered out when importing your schedule. Remove any that were added by mistake.

qr.title: Order QR code
qr.domainLive: This QR code now sends customers to <mono>{domain}</mono>. You never need to print a new one.
qr.domainNotLive: This QR code sends customers to your HatchGrab ordering page. If you set up your own web address later, the same QR code will send them there instead — you will not need to print a new one.
qr.printHelp: Print or display this code so customers can scan and pre-order. Place it at your hatch, on your van, or share it online.
qr.noUrl: No order link yet — your truck’s page address isn’t set.
qr.brandedHelp: Your logo shown in the middle of the QR code
qr.addLogo: Add your logo to your profile and it will show here.
qr.lockedTitle: Branded codes are switched off for your truck
qr.lockedBody: Branded codes are switched off for your truck. Your standard QR code works exactly the same for customers — the difference is your logo in the middle.
qr.buildFailed: That could not be built just now. Try again shortly.
